traceability.evidence: Story file exists: docs/stories/025.0-DEV-CATCH-ANNOTATION-POSITION.story.md (confirmed via check_file_exists)., Implementation for dual-position CatchClause detection and fallback logic is present in src/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.ts:, - gatherCatchClauseCommentText(sourceCode, node, beforeText):, - If beforeText contains @story or @req, it returns beforeText immediately, giving priority to annotations before catch (REQ-POSITION-PRIORITY, REQ-DUAL-POSITION-DETECTION)., - Otherwise, attempts sourceCode.getCommentsInside(node.body) and collects inside comment values (REQ-DUAL-POSITION-DETECTION, REQ-FALLBACK-LOGIC)., - If getCommentsInside is unavailable or throws, falls back to line-based scanning via scanCommentLinesInRange over sourceCode.lines between node.body.loc.start/end (REQ-FALLBACK-LOGIC)., - If no inside comments found, falls back to beforeText (preserves existing behavior)., - gatherBranchCommentText(sourceCode, node, parent):, - For node.type === 'CatchClause', delegates to gatherCatchClauseCommentText, wiring the rule to the dual-position CatchClause logic (IMPL-GATHER-COMMENT-TEXT, IMPL-BRANCH-ANNOTATION-INFO, IMPL-CATCHCLAUSE-HANDLER)., Implementation for Prettier-stable auto-fix position is present in src/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.ts:, - getBaseBranchIndentAndInsertPos(sourceCode, node):, - For CatchClause with a non-empty body, computes indent and insertPos based on the first statement inside the catch block (using firstStatement.loc.start.line), so auto-fix comments are inserted as the first lines inside the catch body (REQ-PRETTIER-AUTOFIX)., - For empty CatchClause bodies, derives indent from the catch block line and adds two-space inner indent, still inside the block body (REQ-PRETTIER-AUTOFIX, empty-catch edge case)., - reportMissingStory / reportMissingReq use the computed indent and insertPos to insert // @story and // @req at the chosen position, so CatchClause auto-fix comments are placed inside the catch block while other branches use before-branch insertion (Auto-Fix Compatibility)., End-to-end rule wiring is present in src/rules/require-branch-annotation.ts:, - "[REQ-DUAL-POSITION-DETECTION] prefers before-catch annotations when present":, - Creates a mock SourceCode where commentsBefore include @story/@req and commentsInside also include different story; gatherBranchCommentText returns the before-catch annotations, confirming before-catch has priority (REQ-POSITION-PRIORITY, REQ-DUAL-POSITION-DETECTION)., - "[REQ-FALLBACK-LOGIC] falls back to inside-catch annotations when before-catch is missing":, - commentsBefore is empty, commentsInside contains @story and @req; gatherBranchCommentText returns inside annotations (REQ-FALLBACK-LOGIC, REQ-DUAL-POSITION-DETECTION)., - "[REQ-FALLBACK-LOGIC] returns before-catch text when getCommentsInside is not available":, - SourceCode omits getCommentsInside; gatherBranchCommentText returns before-catch annotations, proving safe fallback (REQ-FALLBACK-LOGIC)., -
